title: Include PR links in the brief report
spec: Each task row in GET /api/v1/briefs/{id}/report.md links to its PR when pr_url is set. Tasks without a PR (pr_url null) are listed without a link.
acceptance_criteria: tasks with pr_url are rendered as markdown links
tasks without a pr_url are rendered without a link and do not crash the report

defects.note: PRURL is dereferenced without a nil check; a task without a PR panics
